description:
Save an agent for calls, texts, and email replies.

        A handover contact's phone number is hidden from the call agent.
        Saving an agent does not change any phone number's routing.
        Returns the saved agent record or an error.

ai_disclosure.description: Speak the AI disclosure line first on every call.
ai_disclosure.title: Ai Disclosure

ai_disclosure_line.description: Custom AI disclosure line replacing the workspace line. ``{org}`` expands to the organization name.
ai_disclosure_line.title: Ai Disclosure Line

email_enabled.description: Answer email on addresses that route email to this agent.
email_enabled.title: Email Enabled

first_message.description: Greeting spoken after the AI disclosure. Without one, an inbound agent waits for the caller.
first_message.title: First Message

handover_contacts.description: Up to ten ``{contact_id, note}`` entries for people a call can be handed over to. ``contact_id`` is an ID from ``list_contacts``, ``lookup_contact`` or ``create_contact`` (a UUID or ``member:<user_id>``); the contact needs a phone number. ``note`` (1 to 200 characters) says when the agent hands over to that person, such as ``billing questions``.
handover_contacts.title: Handover Contacts

handover_max_duration_seconds.description: Length limit in seconds for a call handed over to a person, 60 to 3600. The default is 1800.
handover_max_duration_seconds.title: Handover Max Duration Seconds

language.description: Spoken language as a lowercase ISO 639-1 code, such as ``es``.
language.title: Language

max_duration_seconds.description: Call length limit in seconds, 60 to 3600.
max_duration_seconds.title: Max Duration Seconds

recording_enabled.description: Recording for this agent's calls. ``true`` or ``false`` overrides the workspace setting.
recording_enabled.title: Recording Enabled

sms_enabled.description: Answer texts on numbers that route texts to this agent.
sms_enabled.title: Sms Enabled

system_prompt.description: Instructions that define the agent's behavior on calls, texts and email replies.
system_prompt.title: System Prompt

tools.description: Names of the tools the agent may use, checked against the server's tool registry. An empty list disables tools.
tools.title: Tools

voice_enabled.description: Answer calls on numbers that route calls to this agent.
voice_enabled.title: Voice Enabled

voice_id.description: Text-to-speech voice ID, applied by whichever voice provider serves the call.
voice_id.title: Voice Id

name: create_agent
title: Create an agent
